note: The artifact chain into a publish job: the wheel builders (run on pull requests and on pushes) build with pypa/cibuildwheel by tag and upload the wheels as artifacts; upload_pypi needs every builder, downloads wheels-* and publishes them with PYPI_API_TOKEN. A new cibuildwheel release runs inside the builder, and whatever it writes into the wheel is what upload_pypi publishes one hop later: mutable dependency, walked along needs and the artifact edge to a job holding the PyPI token and a publish step, is Critical.
